responsibility: Implements 32-bit MIPS ABI lowering for `FnAbi`, tracking running argument offsets to insert required padding, returning aggregates indirectly, and coercing aggregate arguments into i32 register-sized chunks with stack-alignment-aware padding.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/mips.rs`, this MIPS file performs call ABI lowering with running stack/register offset tracking, padding insertion, and aggregate coercion into i32 chunks, instead of defining inline-assembly registers, arch-dependent type support, and reserved-register checks.
